# span end

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spanEnd>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

The ending character offset (unicode code points, zero-based, exclusive) of a span. Pairs with [`gmeow:spanStart`](gmeow-spanStart.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md) from `?` to [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
